description:
Top Three Skills:
 1. C#/ASP.NET (7+ years), 
 2. Experience working on Customer facing websites/portals using tools such as Angular, Bootstrap, Knockout
 3. Full Stack Development experience (SQL on the backend) 
 Job Description:
  The technologies needed for this role are C#, ASP.NET, WCF, and backend/database development. They must be able to write their own stored procedures. MVC experience would be ideal as well. Also, these developers must be comfortable doing development on front-end, middle-tier, and backend development.This resource will mostly be focused on the front end though and integrating web sites into backend . They must be heavily skilled in Web. API and Restful Web Services. The resource should have experience with a broad range of UI tools/technologies. More specifically: Javascript, BootStrap, Knockout, and angular. They will be looking to this resource to give guidance and input on using the right tools for the right job. They currently have Bootstrap and Knockout in the environment. They need at least 7 years of .NET development experience.  They will be interacting with the business along side the business analyst so they must have great communication skills.  


 GOOD COMMUNICATION SKIL

 ONLY EAD,GC or USC 
 
 DURATION:   6 + MONTHS
